question: Tri-Services All-Women Sailing Expedition team returns home after completing two-month-long 1,800-nautical-mile voyage to Seychelles. What was the name of the vessel used in the expedition?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Triveni**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The Tri-Services All-Women Sailing Expedition returned via the indigenously-built Indian Armed Services Vessel called "**Triveni**", a 56-foot sailing yacht.
